info.title: Management Expert API
info.description: Advanced configuration endpoints for Extole platform experts: campaign controllers, typed actions and triggers, advanced component types and facets, source mapping, report post-handlers, pre-handlers, and other expert configuration surfaces not included in the standard Management API.

get.description: Returns all domain pattern definitions for the calling client. Domain patterns define which URL patterns the Extole platform recognises as belonging to this client — they control campaign-tracking domain matching, shareable link generation, and zone-rendering domain allow-listing. Each entry includes its `pattern`, `type` (`GLOB`, `DOMAIN`, or `SUB_DOMAIN`), and the optional `client_domain_id` that links it to a specific program domain configuration.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl "https://api.extole.io/v1/client-domain-patterns" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: application/json"

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript (fetch)
Python (requests)
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests
response = requests.get(
    "https://api.extole.io/v1/client-domain-patterns",
    headers={"Authorization": "Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN", "Accept": "application/json"},
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(len(response.json()))

post.description: Creates a new domain pattern definition and returns the persisted record with its server-assigned id. The `pattern` field is required. `type` defaults to `GLOB` when omitted. Set `test=true` to create a test-only pattern that is not used in production domain matching. The pattern must be buildable; complex `BuildtimeEvaluatable` expressions are evaluated at build time.

x-codeSamples.label: cURL
x-codeSamples.source:
curl -X POST "https://api.extole.io/v1/client-domain-patterns" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -d '{"pattern": "https://example.com/*", "type": "GLOB"}'

x-codeSamples.label: JavaScript (fetch)
Python (requests)
x-codeSamples.source:
import requests
response = requests.post(
    "https://api.extole.io/v1/client-domain-patterns",

        "Accept": "application/json",
    },
    json={"pattern": "https://example.com/*", "type": "GLOB"},
)
response.raise_for_status()
print(response.json()["id"])

get.description: Returns the source definition for the supplied domain pattern, including its `pattern` expression, `type`, optional `client_domain_id`, and `test` flag. Returns `400 client_domain_pattern_not_found` if the id does not exist or is not accessible to the calling client. For the compiled runtime snapshot use `GET /v1/client-domain-patterns/{id}/built` instead.
